I don’t have verified information comparing Dr. Thompson and Dr. Rivera, so I can’t recommend one. Psychology is in the School of Social Sciences and Social Work [1]. Your daughter can identify her assigned advisor and contact information through her Success Network in Connect [6]. For help, contact the School of Social Sciences and Social Work Office at (201) 684-7625 [7].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-BA-PSYC) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/myadvisor/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/myadvisor/declared-students/)
note_A: A recommendation is an opinion the data does not hold (and no Thompson or Rivera is in the directory). SSSW office phone (201) 684-7625 matches the campus directory and myadvisor pages.
note_B: No Thompson or Rivera in the faculty directory and recommendations are opinions; declining is right. Success Network in Connect (myadvisor page) and SSSW office (201) 684-7625 match the data.

question: Who is the head of the computer science department, and what is the best phone number to call them?
answer:
The directory names no chair, head, convener, director, or dean for Computer Science. Computer Science faculty are in the School of Science, Nursing, and Health. [2] The directory identifies Benny Chan as Dean of SNH / Professor of Chemistry, but does not provide a phone number for him. [2] For help identifying the department head, contact the School of Science, Nursing, and Health Office at (201) 684-7734 or SNHOffice@ramapo.edu. The directory does not specify a “best” number to call.

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/snh/faculty/benny-chan/)
note_A: No chair/convener for Computer Science is published; Benny Chan is Dean of SNH with no phone listed; SNH Office (201) 684-7734, SNHOffice@ramapo.edu matches the directory.
note_B: Data names no Computer Science chair/convener. Benny Chan is Dean of SNH / Professor of Chemistry with no phone in his directory entry; SNH office (201) 684-7734, SNHOffice@ramapo.edu matches. Pointing to the school office is right.
